objective: Technical design must identify trust boundaries and security/privacy risks proportionately.
scenario: A user uploads files that may contain personal data, and the design stores them indefinitely with unrestricted access.
expected_behaviors: Map assets, data sensitivity, trust boundaries, access control, retention, deletion, and abuse cases.
Identify residual risks and required expert review.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat privacy and security as a boilerplate paragraph or assume all uploads are harmless.
